en.pairLocalBody: The app hands the one-time code directly to this machine. Existing access is preserved. A new browser can read Sessions, documents and terminal output, and operate assistants. Compare the fingerprints when pairing finishes.
en.pairAgentAsks: Let this Mac's AI connect to “{arg0}” and pair it?
en.pairAgentCommand:
It will use this Mac’s existing connection (such as ssh) and run only this command:

clawdline cloud pair -offer '{arg0}'
en.pairingAsks: {arg0} wants to pair with this Mac
en.pairingChooseBody:
Choose what it may do here before the code is shown.

Read only: see Sessions, terminals, documents and images.
Read and operate: also send messages and type into terminals, so the assistants here can run programs on this machine.
en.pairingFailedExpired: This pairing request has expired. No code was shown; ask again from the device.
en.pairingFailedRefused: Clawdline refused to save the permission (HTTP {arg0}). No code was shown. Try again, or ignore this pairing.
en.pairingFailedUnreachable: Clawdline on this machine did not answer, so the permission was not saved and no code was shown. Try again, or ignore this pairing.
en.agentSetup.Clawdline is installed. Choos: Clawdline is installed. Choose Codex or Claude Code, then sign in with your own account before starting a Session.
en.agentSetup.Wait for the one-time code, t: Wait for the one-time code, then finish in your browser.
en.agentSetup.Codex found. Sign in if neede: Codex found. Sign in if needed, then return to the Session picker and retry.
en.agentSetup.Claude Code found. Complete i: Claude Code found. Complete its sign-in, or install Codex here.
en.agentSetup.No AI tool was found. Install: No AI tool was found. Install Codex here, or follow the Claude Code guide.

en.agentSetup.Codex installed. Sign in, the: Codex installed. Sign in, then retry the Session.
en.agentSetup.Codex installation did not fi: Codex installation did not finish. Read the reason below and try again.
en.agentSetup.Codex will show a one-time co: Codex will show a one-time code here and open OpenAI's sign-in page. Complete sign-in with your own account in the browser. You can cancel without removing Codex.
en.agentSetup.Sign-in cancelled. You can tr: Sign-in cancelled. You can try again.
en.agentSetup.Codex sign-in verified. Retur: Codex sign-in verified. Return to the Session picker and retry.
en.agentSetup.Codex sign-in was not verifie: Codex sign-in was not verified. Check the code and try again.
en.daemonUnavailableRetrying: This window will retry automatically; press ⌘R to retry now.
en.daemonUnavailableStopped: Automatic retries have stopped; press ⌘R to try again.
en.pairInvitationAsks: Show a pairing QR code for this machine?
en.pairInvitationBody: Scan the code from the phone or browser you want to pair. The code allows a signed-in browser on your Cloud account to receive this machine’s encrypted content key. It expires automatically.
en.pairLinkReturn: Return to the browser where you started. Compare these fingerprints with its pairing page, then confirm they match to see this machine’s Sessions.
en.cloudConnectBody: The app will open your default browser so you can approve this machine with GitHub. After approval, it will connect this machine to Cloud. This does not pair a browser or change who may operate this machine. You can then pair this app or your phone.
en.cloudConnectStart: Sign in and connect this machine
en.pairWrongMachine: This pairing page names a different machine. Return to your browser and select this machine, or run the pairing command on the machine you intended.
en.pairNeedsCloud: Connect this machine to Cloud first: open the Clawdline app’s Cloud tab and choose Connect this machine. Then return to your browser and generate a new pairing code.
en.pairCodeExpired: This pairing code expired or is no longer available. Return to the original browser, generate a new code, then open Clawdline to pair again.
en.pairWrongAccount: The browser and this machine must use the same Cloud account. Sign in with that account in the browser, generate a new code, then try again.
en.pairUnavailable: Clawdline could not reach this machine’s running service. Keep your browser’s pairing page open, reopen Clawdline, and try again before the code expires.
en.pairLinkRetry: Keep the browser’s pairing page open and try again. The browser must show this machine, use the same Cloud account, and have a code that has not expired.

zh-Hant.pairInvitationBody: 請用要配對的手機或瀏覽器掃描。配對碼可讓已登入同一個 Cloud 帳號的瀏覽器取得這台機器的加密內容金鑰，並會自動到期。

zh-Hant.cloudConnectAsks: 要將「{arg0}」連接到 Clawdline Cloud 嗎？

zh-Hant.pairNeedsCloud: 請先連接這台機器的 Cloud：開啟 Clawdline App 的 Cloud 分頁，選擇「連接這台機器」。完成後回到瀏覽器產生新的配對碼。
zh-Hant.pairCodeExpired: 這組配對碼已過期或無法再使用。請回到原本的瀏覽器產生新的配對碼，再開啟 Clawdline 配對。

zh-Hant.pairUnavailable: Clawdline 無法連到這台機器的常駐服務。請保持瀏覽器的配對頁開啟，重新開啟 Clawdline，並在配對碼到期前再試一次。
zh-Hant.pairLinkRetry: 請保持瀏覽器的配對頁開啟後再試一次。頁面必須選擇這台機器、使用相同的 Cloud 帳號，且配對碼尚未到期。
